rust_summary: one local client particle through Host::add_particle, retaining the existing provider and engine limits.
doc_summary: `Host::add_particle(&ParticleOptions, position, velocity) -> bool` submits one particle to this client's loaded world. It preserves all option and velocity slots, including encoded color/size arguments, and uses the existing built-in and named-sprite providers with normal camera-distance, Particles-setting and population limits. True means submitted, not necessarily visible; missing providers/sprite sets draw nothing. It returns false on servers, without a client player/level, or for non-finite numeric input. Custom provider registration and new trigger hooks remain separate. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_particles@.
